releases.notes:
The big bunch of nether mob variants have arrived! Each one trying to bring something novel to fighting the particular type of blaze or ghast! 

This update also introduces compatibility with YUNG's Better Nether Fortress on 1.20.1 AND Trial Spawner support for 26.1!
